_comment: Opt-in typecheck for tests/integration — NOT consumed by `pnpm -r typecheck` (which iterates the workspace packages). Trigger explicitly via `pnpm run typecheck:integration`. Extends the root base so module resolution / strictness / NodeNext line up with the rest of the repo. `baseUrl` + `paths` map the workspace package names to their source `.ts` files (instead of relying on workspace symlinks, which don't exist at `tests/integration/node_modules`). NOTE: `fixtures/agent-dir/extensions/test-ext.ts` deliberately hand-writes its own minimal `ExtensionUIContext` interface rather than importing the real `ExtensionUIRouter` shape from `packages/bridge/src/extension-ui.ts`. This was a conscious decoupling (see the long header in `test-ext.ts`) to avoid pulling `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` types into the fixture runtime. Downside: if `ExtensionUIRouter` ever changes the 4 blocking methods' signatures (e.g. `confirm` switches from `(title, message, opts?)` to a different shape), the test fixture's stubbed interface WILL drift and 04-extension-dialogs will fail at the pi runtime boundary, NOT at typecheck time. The `04` cases cover all 4 methods + cancelled end-to-end so the drift surfaces immediately, but be aware the catch is via test failure, not via the compiler.
